_about: Fixed inputs of the live item localiser (loc/live/engine.py) for the corridor site, map hospital_corridor_v2. Made 2026-11-13 from run 2 (corridor_v2_rfid_2laps_run2, 2026-11-07) as processed on abuela (~/rfid_db, commit a2168f4).

map_to_room._note: room_xy = R @ map_xy + t. Fitted on abuela from run 2 corner-tag estimates (dwell_table.py). The same fit on run1b and auto gave yaw 93.1 and 94.2 deg instead of 92.2 and t differing by up to 0.35 m, so a run can sit a few tens of cm off this tie; the offline pipeline refits it per run, the live one cannot.

grid._note: room-frame belief grid, the one of the run-2 replay (path of run 2 +- 1.8 m): 140 x 175 x 17 cells
